WITH filtered_item_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    WHERE item.i_manufact_id = 816
)
SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim dt
JOIN filtered_item_store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item ON ss.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id, item.i_brand
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
